sthr-hour-1.name: Hour I — First Dark
sthr-hour-1.back_flavor: Lanterns bob across the Square. Somewhere a band is tuning up for midnight. Above it all, one by one, the stars begin to go out.
sthr-hour-1.back_text: Set this Hour aside beside the Hours deck. Hour II becomes the current agenda: resolve its “When reached” text.

sthr-hour-2.name: Hour II — Low Water
sthr-hour-2.text: When reached: Each investigator draws 1 encounter card.
sthr-hour-2.back_flavor: The tide draws back from the Long Pier, farther than any tide should, and does not come in again. The harbour smells of something left too long in the dark.
sthr-hour-2.back_text: Set this Hour aside beside the Hours deck. Hour III becomes the current agenda: resolve its “When reached” text.

sthr-hour-3.name: Hour III — The Thirteenth Toll
sthr-hour-3.text: When reached: Raise Dissonance by 1. If any investigator is at a Church location and your Campaign Log does not record The Thirteenth Toll, raise it by 2 instead.
sthr-hour-3.back_flavor: The church bell counts the hour. Twelve. A pause, long enough to hope. Thirteen.
sthr-hour-3.back_text: Set this Hour aside beside the Hours deck. Hour IV becomes the current agenda (if Hour IV has been removed, Hour V does): resolve its “When reached” text.

sthr-hour-4.name: Hour IV — The Road Gives Way
sthr-hour-4.text: When reached: The lead investigator chooses a revealed location other than the Square with the fewest clues. Until the Hourglass next advances or rewinds, it is impassable. Each investigator there moves to a connecting location of their choice (this does not place doom).
sthr-hour-4.back_flavor: Out past the Milestones the road simply stops being there. The walkers on it do not break stride.
sthr-hour-4.back_text: Set this Hour aside beside the Hours deck. Hour V becomes the current agenda: resolve its “When reached” text.

sthr-hour-5.name: Hour V — The Streets Empty
sthr-hour-5.text: When reached: The Appointed's Approach advances to at least Sensed.
sthr-hour-5.back_flavor: The fair's music plays on for no one. Doors stand open along every street. The town has gone somewhere without moving.
sthr-hour-5.back_text: Set this Hour aside beside the Hours deck. Hour VI becomes the current agenda: resolve its “When reached” text.

sthr-hour-6.name: Hour VI — The Wrong Sky
sthr-hour-6.text: When reached: Add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of the loop. If your Campaign Log records What the Almanac Hid, instead: until the end of the loop, the chaos bag holds 1 fewer Static token than its band calls for (never fewer than 0). (This does not stack: if Hour VI has already resolved this loop, it has no further effect.)
sthr-hour-6.back_flavor: The sky is wrong in a new way now: a starless patch the shape of an open door, fraying at its edges.
sthr-hour-6.back_text: Set this Hour aside beside the Hours deck. Hour VII becomes the current agenda: resolve its “When reached” text.

sthr-hour-7.name: Hour VII — The Guest Approaches
sthr-hour-7.text: When reached: The Appointed's Approach advances to at least Emerging. If your Campaign Log records The Appointed's Name, exhaust the Appointed.
sthr-hour-7.back_flavor: Every dog in Ambergrove faces the same way. Something is coming up the hill toward the Square, politely, with all the time in the world.
sthr-hour-7.back_text: Set this Hour aside beside the Hours deck. Hour VIII becomes the current agenda: resolve its “When reached” text.

sthr-hour-8.name: Hour VIII — Almost
sthr-hour-8.text: When reached: Raise Dissonance by 2. The Appointed's Approach advances to Arrived. Until the end of the loop, each enemy gets +1 fight (including enemies that enter play later; this does not stack).
sthr-hour-8.back_flavor: One minute to midnight. It has been one minute to midnight for a very long time. The seam in the sky pulls taut.
sthr-hour-8.back_text: Set this Hour aside beside the Hours deck. Hour IX becomes the current agenda: resolve its “When reached” text.

sthr-hour-9.name: Hour IX — The Appointed Hour
sthr-hour-9.text: When reached: In the Prologue, (→R2). In the finale, the finale ends and the contest is not reached. Otherwise, the loop ends (→Loop Resolution 1), unless your Campaign Log records The Way the Night Breaks and you begin the finale instead.
sthr-hour-9.back_flavor: The occultation completes, exactly as the almanac promised.

sthr-losthour.name: Lost Hour
sthr-losthour.text: Revelation – Advance the Hourglass by 1 Hour.

sthr-slippage.name: Slippage
sthr-slippage.text:
Surge.
Revelation – Add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of the round.

sthr-waitingcongregation.name: The Waiting Congregation
sthr-waitingcongregation.text:
Sleepwalking.
Prey – Most Memory on their cards.
While Dissonance is in the Glitch band or higher, the Waiting Congregation gains hunter.

sthr-drownedchoir.name: The Drowned Choir
sthr-drownedchoir.text:
Sleepwalking. Aloof.
Forced – After the Drowned Choir wakes: Each investigator at its location takes 1 horror. Limit once per loop.

sthr-familiarface.name: Familiar Face
sthr-familiarface.text:
Sleepwalking.
Prey – Most Memory on their cards.
Spawn – The location of the investigator with the most Memory on their cards (the lead investigator breaks ties).
Forced – After you defeat Familiar Face: Place 1 Memory on your investigator card.
sthr-familiarface.flavor: You will remember this face too.

sthr-lamplighterecho.name: The Lamplighter's Echo
sthr-lamplighterecho.text:
Sleepwalking.
While the Ambergrove Lamp (the asset) is in play, the Lamplighter's Echo is not Sleepwalking, even while the Lantern Room's lamp is lit, and gains retaliate.

sthr-wrongturn.name: Wrong Turn
sthr-wrongturn.text: Revelation – Each investigator moves to a connecting location of the lead investigator's choice. These moves do not place doom on the current Hour.
sthr-wrongturn.flavor: The map is not where you left it.

sthr-rewind.name: Stutter
sthr-rewind.text:
Peril.
Revelation – If you discovered a clue during your most recent turn and still have a clue, place 1 of your clues on the location where you last discovered a clue. Otherwise, take 2 horror.

sthr-deadair.name: Dead Air
sthr-deadair.text: Revelation – Add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of your next turn. Until then, each Static token is −4 instead of −3.

sthr-loopnotices.name: The Loop Notices You
sthr-loopnotices.text: Revelation – Raise Dissonance by 1. If, during your most recent turn, you played or committed a Recollection or paid “raise Dissonance” as a cost, raise it by 2 instead.

sthr-yearinanight.name: A Year in a Night
sthr-yearinanight.text:
Peril.
Revelation – Test [wil] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror. If you fail by 2 or more, also gain 1 Year (record it now; it takes effect Between Loops).

sthr-forgotten.name: What You've Forgotten
sthr-forgotten.text: Revelation – Remove 1 Memory from among the cards you control. If you cannot, take 1 horror.

sthr-oldbones.name: Old Bones
sthr-oldbones.text:
Peril.
Revelation – If you are Elder or Ancient, take 2 damage; otherwise, take 1 damage. If you are Elder or Ancient and no card in your hand has a [com], [agi] or [wild] icon (reveal your hand), take 1 horror.
sthr-oldbones.flavor: Your body remembers what your mind won't.

sthr-crossing.name: The Crossing
sthr-crossing.text: Revelation – Advance the Appointed's Approach by 1 stage. Then raise Dissonance by 1.

sthr-loc-square.name: The Square
sthr-loc-square.flavor: Everyone is out for the occultation. None of them will look at you twice — not this time, not ever.

sthr-loc-longpier.name: The Long Pier
sthr-loc-longpier.flavor: You came to Ambergrove for your own reasons. You will not remember why, soon.
sthr-loc-longpier.unrevealed_flavor: Planks run out over black water. At the far end, someone is waiting for a boat that is not coming.
sthr-loc-longpier.text: [action]: Test [wil] (2). If you succeed, place 1 Memory on your investigator card. Group limit once per game.

sthr-loc-almanacsteps.name: The Almanac Steps
sthr-loc-almanacsteps.text: Forced – After you enter the Almanac Steps: Raise Dissonance by 1.
sthr-loc-almanacsteps.unrevealed_flavor: The printing house's stone steps, worn hollow in the middle. A light burns behind the upper windows.
sthr-loc-almanacsteps.flavor: Worn hollow by a hundred years of townsfolk coming to read the date.

tokens.text: -1. If Dissonance is in the Glitch band or higher, -2 instead.
-2. If you fail by 2 or more, raise Dissonance by 1.
-2. If the Appointed is Emerging or later, take 1 horror.
-3. If you fail, place 1 doom on the current Hour.

back_tokens.text: -2. If Dissonance is in the Glitch band or higher, -3 instead.
-4. If the Appointed is Sensed or later, take 1 horror. If it is Arrived, also take 1 damage.
-5. If you fail, place 1 doom on the current Hour.

sthr-loc-lanternroom.name: The Lantern Room
sthr-loc-lanternroom.text: When your Campaign Log records The Lamp Was Never Lit, this location enters play calm side up (revealed).
sthr-loc-lanternroom.flavor: The light remembers a path the dark has forgotten.
sthr-loc-lanternroom.back_text:
Calm side (your Campaign Log records The Lamp Was Never Lit).
[action]: Light the lamp. It stays lit until the end of the loop.
While the Lantern Room's lamp is lit, each Echo in the Lighthouse and Sunken Road districts is Sleepwalking while Dissonance is in the Calm or Glitch band (unless another effect says it is not Sleepwalking), and The Dark That Waits treats investigators here as not at the Lantern Room.
sthr-loc-lanternroom.back_flavor: You know how to light it now. Some part of you always did.

sthr-loc-windingstair.name: The Winding Stair
sthr-loc-windingstair.text:
Investigators cannot move from the Winding Stair to the Lantern Room except with this ability.
[action]: Test [agi] (2). If you succeed, move to the Lantern Room. If you fail, take 1 damage.
sthr-loc-windingstair.unrevealed_flavor: Iron steps spiral up into the dark. You can hear them ring under feet that are not yours.

sthr-loc-keepersquarters.name: The Keeper's Quarters
sthr-loc-keepersquarters.text: [action][action]: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror. Limit once per round.
sthr-loc-keepersquarters.unrevealed_flavor: A narrow door at the foot of the tower, painted the same green as a hundred years of salt allowed.

sthr-darkthatwaits.name: The Dark That Waits
sthr-darkthatwaits.text: Revelation – If you are at the Lantern Room, take 2 horror. Otherwise, take 1 horror.

sthr-loc-nave.name: The Nave
sthr-loc-nave.flavor: The congregation is still here. They have been kneeling since the first toll.
sthr-loc-nave.unrevealed_flavor: Water laps at the church doors. Inside, lamplight lies on it like oil.

sthr-loc-belfry.name: The Belfry
sthr-loc-belfry.flavor: The bell tolled thirteen times. The thirteenth is the sound the night is stuck on.
sthr-loc-belfry.unrevealed_flavor: The bell rope disappears up through a hole in the ceiling. It is swaying, though there is no wind.
sthr-loc-belfry.text: Forced – After you enter the Belfry: If your Campaign Log does not record The Thirteenth Toll, raise Dissonance by 1.

sthr-loc-floodedcrypt.name: The Flooded Crypt
sthr-loc-floodedcrypt.text: Closed. It opens when The Hour Was Wrong becomes the current act. Once your Campaign Log records The Hour Was Wrong, it enters play open (revealed).
sthr-loc-floodedcrypt.unrevealed_flavor: Steps go down into the water and do not come up again.
sthr-loc-floodedcrypt.flavor: The water is colder than the sea it came from.

sthr-loc-vestry.name: The Vestry
sthr-loc-vestry.text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Lower Dissonance by 1. Group limit once per round.
sthr-loc-vestry.unrevealed_flavor: A side door, a brass plate, a key left in the lock as though someone meant to come back.
sthr-loc-vestry.flavor: Vestments hang in a row, stiff with salt. One peg is empty.

sthr-thirteen.name: Thirteen
sthr-thirteen.text: Revelation – Place 1 doom on the current Hour. If you are at a Church location, also raise Dissonance by 1.

sthr-risingwater.name: Rising Water
sthr-risingwater.text: Revelation – Your location gets +1 shroud until the end of the round.

sthr-loc-milestones.name: The Milestones
sthr-loc-milestones.flavor: The road between the town and the shore, counted out in stones that never change.
sthr-loc-milestones.unrevealed_flavor: Stone markers along the verge, each one carved with a number. The numbers do not go in order.

sthr-loc-lowbridge.name: The Low Bridge
sthr-loc-lowbridge.flavor: The water never quite reaches the top. It never quite goes down.
sthr-loc-lowbridge.unrevealed_flavor: A humpbacked bridge over a stream that should not be this deep.

sthr-loc-turning.name: The Turning
sthr-loc-turning.text: [action] Raise Dissonance by 2: Rewind the Hourglass by 1 Hour. Group limit once per loop.
sthr-loc-turning.unrevealed_flavor: The road bends toward the shore and out of sight. Every hooded walker takes the bend the same way.
sthr-loc-turning.flavor: Every walker takes the bend the same way. You could turn back.

sthr-bridgeremembers.name: The Bridge Remembers
sthr-bridgeremembers.text: Revelation – If you moved into or out of the Low Bridge during your most recent turn or since it ended, place 1 doom on the current Hour. Otherwise, The Bridge Remembers gains surge.

sthr-loc-townhallsteps.name: The Town Hall Steps
sthr-loc-townhallsteps.text: When your Campaign Log records The Sheriff Is Already Dead, this location enters play calm side up (revealed).
sthr-loc-townhallsteps.flavor: The sheriff gives the same speech to the same crowd. He has been giving it since ten o'clock.
sthr-loc-townhallsteps.back_text:
Calm side (your Campaign Log records The Sheriff Is Already Dead).
[free]: Name an Hour after the current Hour, other than Hour IX. The next time it is reached this loop, cancel its “When reached” text. Group limit once per loop.
sthr-loc-townhallsteps.back_flavor: The records let you read the night ahead.

sthr-loc-recordsoffice.name: The Records Office
sthr-loc-recordsoffice.text: [action] Spend 2 clues: An investigator at the Records Office who gained Years from a card effect during this loop loses 1 of those Years. Group limit once per loop.
sthr-loc-recordsoffice.unrevealed_flavor: Town Hall's back rooms: ledgers, deeds, and the smell of dust that has been disturbed recently.
sthr-loc-recordsoffice.flavor: Every decision the town ever made, filed where no one will look.

sthr-loc-well.name: The Well
sthr-loc-well.text: Forced – After you enter the Well: If your Campaign Log does not record The Sheriff Is Already Dead, take 1 horror.
sthr-loc-well.unrevealed_flavor: An old stone well at the edge of the Square, capped with a board. Something has scratched at the board from beneath.
sthr-loc-well.flavor: The board over its mouth is scored on the underside.

sthr-samespeech.name: The Same Speech
sthr-samespeech.text:
Peril.
Revelation – Take 1 horror, plus 1 horror for every 3 completed loops (maximum 3 more).
sthr-samespeech.flavor: He has been dead since ten o'clock. No one has noticed but you.

sthr-crowdturns.name: The Crowd Turns
sthr-crowdturns.text: Revelation – Until the end of the round, each Echo enemy in play is not Sleepwalking. Ready each Echo enemy in play. If there is no Echo enemy in play, The Crowd Turns gains surge.

sthr-loc-wheel.name: The Wheel
sthr-loc-wheel.text: Forced – After the Hourglass advances: Each investigator at the Wheel takes 1 horror.
sthr-loc-wheel.unrevealed_flavor: The great wheel turns against the wrong sky, every car lit, every car empty.
sthr-loc-wheel.flavor: From the top, the whole town holds still.

sthr-loc-hallofmirrors.name: The Hall of Mirrors
sthr-loc-hallofmirrors.unrevealed_flavor: A painted door: SEE YOURSELF AS OTHERS SEE YOU. The paint is still wet.
sthr-loc-hallofmirrors.text: [action]: You gain 1 Year (record it now; it takes effect Between Loops). Place 2 Memory on your investigator card. Group limit once per loop.

sthr-loc-ticketbooth.name: The Ticket Booth
sthr-loc-ticketbooth.text: Forced – After you enter the Ticket Booth: If your Campaign Log does not record You hold the ticket, lose 1 resource.
sthr-loc-ticketbooth.unrevealed_flavor: A striped booth at the fair's gate. The window is lit. The ticket-taker is not looking at you, and then he is.
sthr-loc-ticketbooth.flavor: ADMIT ONE. No price is posted.

sthr-wheelsturn.name: The Wheel's Turn
sthr-wheelsturn.text: Revelation – Place 1 doom on the current Hour. Then each investigator gains 1 resource.

sthr-reflectionlies.name: Your Reflection Lies
sthr-reflectionlies.text: Revelation – If you are at the Hall of Mirrors, take 2 horror and add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of the round. Otherwise, take 1 horror.

sthr-loc-readingroom.name: The Reading Room
sthr-loc-readingroom.flavor: Ayako has read every book in it a hundred times.
sthr-loc-readingroom.unrevealed_flavor: Shelves to the ceiling, and a long table laid with open almanacs, all turned to the same page.

sthr-loc-press.name: The Press
sthr-loc-press.text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Remove from the chaos bag 1 Static token that a card effect added until the end of a turn or round. Group limit once per round.
sthr-loc-press.unrevealed_flavor: The iron press stands inked and ready. The type in its bed has already been set.
sthr-loc-press.flavor: It has printed the same page all night. The ink is always wet.

sthr-loc-sealedstudy.name: The Sealed Study
sthr-loc-sealedstudy.text:
Closed. It opens when The Appointed's Name becomes the current act. Once your Campaign Log records The Appointed's Name, it enters play open (revealed).
[free]: Begin the finale. Only during your turn, and only if your Campaign Log records The Way the Night Breaks.
sthr-loc-sealedstudy.unrevealed_flavor: A study door that no key in Ambergrove fits.
sthr-loc-sealedstudy.flavor: Inside, it is eleven o'clock exactly, and always has been.

sthr-pagethatwasnt.name: The Page That Wasn't
sthr-pagethatwasnt.text:
Peril.
Revelation – Take 1 horror for every 6 banked Memory, rounded up (maximum 3).
sthr-pagethatwasnt.flavor: In one loop she found a page that was not there in the others.

sthr-inkrunsbackward.name: Ink Runs Backward
sthr-inkrunsbackward.text: Revelation – The next time a clue would be discovered at your current location this round, cancel that discovery. (This effect stays with that location.)

sthr-studydoor.name: The Study Door
sthr-studydoor.text: Revelation – If the Sealed Study is closed, add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the end of the round. Otherwise, The Study Door gains surge.

sthr-loc-hubsquare.name: The Square
sthr-loc-hubsquare.text: Each loop begins here. The first time each round any investigator moves along a given connection between two districts, place 1 doom on the current Hour (see the Campaign Guide).
sthr-loc-hubsquare.flavor: Everyone is out for the occultation. None of them will look at you twice — not this time, not ever.

sthr-act-firsthour.name: The First Hour
sthr-act-firsthour.text:
Objective – If the current Hour is Hour V or later, investigators at the Almanac Steps may, as a group, spend 4 [perinv] clues to advance.
If Hour IX is reached first, (→R2).
sthr-act-firsthour.flavor: The almanac promised the occultation at midnight. It is eleven, and the sky is already wrong.
sthr-act-firsthour.back_flavor: You were standing on the right step at the right second. You watched the occultation complete, and you watched something reach through, and not finish reaching. When the night folds, you fold with it on purpose.

sthr-story-firstreset.name: The First Reset
sthr-story-firstreset.text:
The Prologue ends. In your Campaign Log, record You Are Unstuck.
Then turn to the Prologue resolutions in the Campaign Guide and read the one that applies.

sthr-act-lamp.name: Light the Lamp
sthr-act-lamp.text: Objective – [action] Spend 3 [perinv] clues: Test [wil] (3) or [com] (3). Only an investigator at the Lantern Room may use this ability; investigators at the Lantern Room may contribute the clues. If you succeed, advance. If you fail, place 1 [perinv] clues from the token pool on the Lantern Room.
sthr-act-lamp.flavor: The lamp is dark. It has never, in any loop, been lit.
sthr-act-lamp.back_flavor: The wick takes on the third try. For the first time in more nights than anyone can count, the beam swings out across the water, and down on the Sunken Road every walker stops and turns to face the light.
sthr-act-lamp.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Lamp Was Never Lit.
The Lantern Room's lamp is lit until the end of this loop. While it is lit, each Echo in the Lighthouse and Sunken Road districts is Sleepwalking while Dissonance is in the Calm or Glitch band (unless another effect says it is not Sleepwalking), and The Dark That Waits treats investigators at the Lantern Room as not at the Lantern Room.
From now on the Lantern Room is calm side up: flip it now (do not add clues), and in every later loop it enters play calm side up.
In Part II, advance to act 2a if its requirements are met. Otherwise, remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-ninthdeath.text:
Part II only.
Objective – If the Lantern Room's lamp is lit, investigators at the Keeper's Quarters may, as a group, spend 3 [perinv] clues to advance.
sthr-act-ninthdeath.flavor: Elias kept the log for years. He does not remember writing most of it.
sthr-act-ninthdeath.back_flavor: Eight deaths in Elias's own careful hand, each one dated tonight. The ninth line is ruled and waiting.
sthr-act-ninthdeath.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Keeper's Ninth Death.
From now on, when Elias's [elder] heals damage, it also heals 1 horror.
The Lighthouse's objectives are complete. From now on, do not use this act deck when you Place this box.

sthr-act-whythirteen.name: Why Thirteen?
sthr-act-whythirteen.text: Objective – If an investigator is at the Vestry, the investigators may, as a group, spend 5 [perinv] clues to advance.
sthr-act-whythirteen.flavor: The bell tolled thirteen times at the first occultation. It should toll twelve.
sthr-act-whythirteen.back_flavor: The register lists every service since the church was raised, and every entry ends at twelve. On the night of the first occultation, in a different ink, someone has added a thirteenth stroke, pressed so hard the nib tore the page.
sthr-act-whythirteen.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Thirteenth Toll.
Hour III no longer raises Dissonance by 2 at a Church location.
In Part II, advance to act 2a if its requirements are met. Otherwise, remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-hourwaswrong.name: The Hour Was Wrong
sthr-act-hourwaswrong.text:
Part II only.
Forced – When this act becomes the current act: The Flooded Crypt opens. Spawn the set-aside Bell-Ringer Beneath there.
Objective – Investigators at the Flooded Crypt may, as a group, spend 5 [perinv] clues to advance.
sthr-act-hourwaswrong.flavor: Below the bell, below the water, the church keeps what it was told to keep.
sthr-act-hourwaswrong.back_flavor: The page is soft as wet cloth, but the ink held. The same almanac, the same night, and a different hour. Someone set the occultation an hour wrong, and the town has been standing in the gap ever since.
sthr-act-hourwaswrong.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Hour Was Wrong.
Remove Hour IV from the game now unless it is the current Hour (if it is, remove it as soon as it stops being the current Hour), and during every later Loop Setup. The Hourglass steps over it in both directions.
The Drowned Church's objectives are complete. From now on, do not use this act deck when you Place this box.

sthr-act-walkbackward.name: Walk It Backward
sthr-act-walkbackward.text: Objective – Advance when one investigator has discovered 1 [perinv] clues at the Turning, then 1 [perinv] clues at the Low Bridge, then 1 [perinv] clues at the Milestones, in that order, during this loop. (Keep a separate pile of resources from the token pool on this act for each investigator, 1 per clue that counts.)
sthr-act-walkbackward.flavor: The same figures walk it every loop, in the same direction, never arriving.
sthr-act-walkbackward.back_flavor: Walking against them, you see the road the way the walkers never do: from the shore back toward town. The milestones count down instead of up. You will not lose your way on this road again.
sthr-act-walkbackward.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Road Remembers.
Group limit once per loop: moving between the Square and the Milestones does not place doom on the current Hour.
In Part II, advance to act 2a if its requirements are met. Otherwise, remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-walksbeside.name: Who Walks Beside You
sthr-act-walksbeside.text:
Part II only.
Forced – When this act becomes the current act: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Waiting Congregation, spawn it at the Turning and shuffle the encounter deck. While this act is the current act, each Echo at the Turning is not Sleepwalking.
Objective – [action]: Stand Firm. Only an investigator at the Turning may use this ability. Choose a ready Echo at the Turning and test [wil] (X) or [com] (X), where X is its fight value. If you succeed, exhaust it. After an investigator evades an Echo at the Turning or succeeds at Stand Firm, advance.
sthr-act-walksbeside.flavor: Some of them turn to look at you now.
sthr-act-walksbeside.back_flavor: The face under the hood is worn almost smooth, like a step a thousand feet have climbed. You know the coat. You know the ring on the hand that lifts to stop you. They were here before you, and they looped until there was nothing left to loop.
sthr-act-walksbeside.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: Who Walks Beside You.
While your Campaign Log records Who Walks Beside You, each Echo gets −1 fight.
The Sunken Road's objectives are complete. From now on, do not use this act deck when you Place this box.

sthr-act-sheriffdead.name: The Sheriff Is Already Dead
sthr-act-sheriffdead.text: Objective – If an investigator is at the Well, the investigators may, as a group, spend 5 [perinv] clues to advance.
sthr-act-sheriffdead.flavor: He has been dead since ten o'clock. No one has noticed but you.
sthr-act-sheriffdead.back_flavor: He is at the bottom of the Well, and he has been there since ten o'clock. Up on the Town Hall steps, the sheriff clears his throat and begins the speech again.
sthr-act-sheriffdead.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Sheriff Is Already Dead.
From now on the Town Hall Steps are calm side up: flip them now (do not add clues), and in every later loop they enter play calm side up.
In Part II, advance to act 2a if its requirements are met. Otherwise, remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-vote.name: The Vote That Never Ends
sthr-act-vote.text:
Part II only.
Forced – When this act becomes the current act: Spawn the set-aside What Wears the Sheriff at the Records Office.
Objective – Investigators at the Records Office may, as a group, spend 5 [perinv] clues to advance.
sthr-act-vote.flavor: The Records Office keeps every decision the town ever made. It keeps this one in a locked drawer.
sthr-act-vote.back_flavor: The minutes are dated the night of the first occultation. A motion to open the door. Every name in Ambergrove, each in its own hand. Carried, unanimous. Under the tally a clerk has written: the cost to be settled at the appointed hour.
sthr-act-vote.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Vote That Never Ends. If Seraphine Vale is at the Records Office, mark Seraphine's thread “suspected.”
The Square's objectives are complete. From now on, do not use this act deck when you Place this box.

sthr-act-wheelturns.name: The Wheel Still Turns
sthr-act-wheelturns.text: Objective – [action] Spend 3 [perinv] clues: Test [agi] (3). Only an investigator at the Wheel may use this ability; investigators at the Wheel may contribute the clues. If you succeed, advance. If you fail, place 1 [perinv] clues from the token pool on the Wheel.
sthr-act-wheelturns.flavor: You see the whole town at once.
sthr-act-wheelturns.back_flavor: From the top of the Wheel, Ambergrove lies spread out like a map on a table: the Square, the church, the road running out to the lighthouse. Every street is full, and nobody is moving.
sthr-act-wheelturns.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Wheel Still Turns.
From now on, while your Campaign Log records The Wheel Still Turns: [free]: Look at the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and put them back in any order. Only an investigator at the Wheel may use this ability. Group limit once per loop.
In Part II, advance to act 2a if its requirements are met. Otherwise, remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-bargain.name: The Ticket-Taker's Bargain
sthr-act-bargain.text:
Part II only.
Objective – [action] Spend 5 [perinv] clues: Parley. Only an investigator at the Ticket Booth may use this ability; investigators at the Ticket Booth may contribute the clues. Advance.
sthr-act-bargain.flavor: He smiles at you like he's been expecting you for a very long time.
sthr-act-bargain.back_flavor: He does not ask your name. He tells you there is a way out of the night, that the fare is steep, and that he has waited a very long time for someone who could afford it.
sthr-act-bargain.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Ticket-Taker's Bargain.
The Fairground's objectives are complete. From now on, do not use this act deck when you Place this box.

sthr-act-almanachid.name: What the Almanac Hid
sthr-act-almanachid.text: Objective – If an investigator is at the Press, the investigators may, as a group, spend 5 [perinv] clues to advance.
sthr-act-almanachid.flavor: Where the wrong almanac was printed.
sthr-act-almanachid.back_flavor: The press groans and runs. The pages come out warm, and wrong in a new way: the hour printed on them is the right one. For a moment the sky over the Almanac House looks almost ordinary.
sthr-act-almanachid.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: What the Almanac Hid.
At Hour VI, the chaos bag holds 1 fewer Static token for the rest of the loop instead of 1 more.
In Part II, advance to act 2a if its requirements are met. Otherwise, remove this act deck from the game.

sthr-act-appointedname.name: The Appointed's Name
sthr-act-appointedname.text:
Part II only, once your Campaign Log records What the Almanac Hid and The Vote That Never Ends.
Forced – When this act becomes the current act: The Sealed Study opens.
Objective – Investigators at the Sealed Study may, as a group, spend 5 [perinv] clues to advance.
sthr-act-appointedname.flavor: Inside is the name the town spoke to call the thing through.
sthr-act-appointedname.back_flavor: It is written once, in the middle of an otherwise blank page. You read it. You do not say it aloud. Somewhere on the hill, something pauses mid-step.
sthr-act-appointedname.back_text:
Record in your Campaign Log: The Appointed's Name. If Seraphine Vale is at the Sealed Study, mark Seraphine's thread “known.”
At Hour VII, exhaust the Appointed.
If your Campaign Log records The Appointed's Name, The Vote That Never Ends and at least one other deep entry, also record The Way the Night Breaks: the finale may now be begun. If it does not yet, check again each time you record a deep entry.
The Almanac House's objectives are complete. From now on, do not use this act deck when you Place this box.

sthr-act-lasthour.name: Contest the Crossing
sthr-act-lasthour.text:
Objective – Gain 1 contest progress each time an investigator succeeds at Hold Back or spends a deep Knowledge entry. Other sources are in the Campaign Guide. When progress reaches 7 (8 with four investigators), advance.
[action]: Spend a deep Knowledge entry your Campaign Log records (each entry once per finale).
If Hour IX is reached, every investigator is defeated, or Dissonance reaches the reset value, the finale ends and the contest is not reached.
sthr-act-lasthour.flavor: An appointment made in ink and never kept.
sthr-act-lasthour.back_flavor: The crossing holds. For one long breath the night stops pressing, and every clock in Ambergrove agrees on the time.
sthr-act-lasthour.back_text: The contest is reached. The investigators must decide how to end the night: turn to the Finale Resolutions in the Campaign Guide and choose one resolution from R1, R1b, R2, R3 or R4 whose condition you meet (R4 is always available).

sthr-res-1.name: Take Its Place
sthr-res-1.text:
Contest reached, and an Ancient investigator, or the investigator who signed the ninth line, is present.
Choose one such present investigator: they become the night's new anchor, kept behind, decades older, so the loop ends for everyone else. Mark them kept as anchor.
If your Campaign Log records Who Walks Beside You, instead: at dawn the anchor walks out with the others, free and not kept, 3 Years older (1 Year if the walkers keep their ring).

sthr-res-2.name: Close the Door
sthr-res-2.text:
Contest reached, and your Campaign Log records The Vote That Never Ends, The Appointed's Name and The vote still stands.
You pay the price the town agreed to and never paid: each present investigator gains 3 Years (2 if the town was warned), and the door closes.

sthr-res-3.name: Break Through
sthr-res-3.text:
Contest reached, and your Campaign Log records The Keeper's Ninth Death.
Every present investigator escapes, but the loop is only paused. If the ninth line was left blank, the loop stays ended.

sthr-res-4.name: Seal by Force
sthr-res-4.text:
Contest reached.
The investigators choose one present investigator: they age out holding the door shut. If the vote was torn out, they instead gain 3 Years and walk away.

sthr-res-5.name: Next Time
sthr-res-5.text:
Contest not reached, and banked Memory is at least 4 per investigator.
The loop wins tonight, but you wake at First Dark closer than ever. Mark this loop Closed at the Hour and proceed to Between Loops; the finale may be begun again.

sthr-res-6.name: The Loop Wins
sthr-res-6.text:
Contest not reached, and banked Memory is below 4 per investigator.
The night takes you. The campaign ends.
sthr-res-6.flavor: The town keeps repeating — and somewhere on the Sunken Road, walking the same direction and never arriving, there are new faces beneath the hoods.

sthr-story-actii.name: The Shape of the Hour
sthr-story-actii.text:
Read at Between Loops when Part II begins (3 or more surface Knowledge entries recorded, or Loop 3 completed).
The town has begun to notice that you notice. Somewhere past the edge of the Square, something that has been waiting politely decides to stop waiting.
From the next loop: each district's act 2a opens, the Appointed's Whispers join the encounter deck, and the Named enter the night.

sthr-story-beforefinale.name: The Last Hour
sthr-story-beforefinale.text: You know the shape of the night now. You know what it costs to end it. The only question left is who pays.
sthr-story-beforefinale.flavor: You have lived this night more times than you can hold.

sthr-res-bargain.name: Let It In, On Your Terms
sthr-res-bargain.text:
Contest reached, your Campaign Log records The Ticket-Taker's Bargain and You hold the ticket, and banked Memory is at least 4 per investigator (3 per investigator if you kept the night to yourselves).
The door opens on your terms and the night finally ends. Banked Memory drops to 0, and each present investigator gains 2 Years.
sthr-res-bargain.flavor: He punches your ticket without looking. He has been expecting you for a very long time.

sthr-bandonsteps.name: The Band on the Steps
sthr-bandonsteps.text:
Sleepwalking.
Spawn – The Town Hall Steps.
While the Band on the Steps is not Sleepwalking, investigators at its location cannot play events.
sthr-bandonsteps.flavor: The tune never reaches its last bar.

sthr-drownedverger.name: The Drowned Verger
sthr-drownedverger.text:
Aloof.
Spawn – The Vestry.
Forced – After you discover a clue at the Vestry: If the Drowned Verger is at the Vestry, ready and unengaged, it engages you.
sthr-drownedverger.flavor: He still keeps the register. He does not like it read.

sthr-milecounter.name: The Mile-Counter
sthr-milecounter.text:
Hunter.
Spawn – The Milestones.
Forced – After the Mile-Counter moves: Place 1 resource on it from the token pool. If there are 3 or more resources on it, remove them and place 1 doom on the current Hour.

sthr-barker.name: The Barker
sthr-barker.text:
Hunter.
Prey – Most resources.
Spawn – The Ticket Booth.
Forced – After the Barker attacks you: Lose 2 resources.

sthr-compositor.name: The Compositor
sthr-compositor.text:
Retaliate.
Spawn – The Press.
Forced – After an investigator at the Compositor's location fails a skill test: Raise Dissonance by 1. Limit once per round.

sthr-uninvited.name: The Uninvited
sthr-uninvited.text:
Hunter.
Prey – Most Memory on their cards.
Forced – After the Uninvited is defeated: Gain 1 contest progress. Remove it from the game.
sthr-uninvited.flavor: It followed the guest in. It has not been asked to leave.

sthr-bellringer.text:
Retaliate.
Spawn – The Flooded Crypt.
Forced – After Hour III is reached, if the Bell-Ringer Beneath is in play: Ready it. It attacks the nearest investigator at its location or a connecting location (the lead investigator breaks ties).

sthr-appointed-approach.text:
The Approach advances only when an effect says so: Hour V (to at least Sensed), Hour VII (at least Emerging), Hour VIII (Arrived); Dissonance entering the Glitch band (at least Sensed) or the Noticed band (Arrived); The Crossing and The Debt of Hours (1 stage); finale setup (Arrived). It never goes above Arrived.
When the Approach becomes Sensed or later while the Appointed is set aside, put it into play at the revealed location farthest from all investigators that is not closed (the lead investigator breaks ties). When it is pushed back to Unseen, set it aside.
While Sensed: It gains aloof and cannot move or attack. Forced – At the end of the round: The Appointed deals 1 horror to each investigator at its location.
While Emerging: It gains hunter and cannot attack. Forced – After the Appointed engages an investigator: The Appointed deals 1 horror to that investigator.
While Arrived: It gains hunter. Forced – After the Appointed attacks: Raise Dissonance by 1.
sthr-appointed-approach.name: The Appointed's Approach

sthr-itmeanswait.text: Fast. Play only if there are 3 or more banked Memory. Play when one of these would resolve: an Hour's “When reached” text (except Hour IX); the revelation ability of Lost Hour, Slippage, The Crossing or The Appointed's Whisper; an attack by the Appointed against you; or an ability on The Appointed's Approach that would make you take horror. Cancel that effect.

sthr-dejavu.text: Fast. As an additional cost to play Déjà Vu, raise Dissonance by 1. Play during your turn, after you resolve an [action], [free] or [reaction] ability on an asset or investigator card you control, if that ability has not reached its limit. Resolve it again, paying its costs again except [action] and any cost to exhaust a card. This counts toward its limits.

sthr-thistimeforsure.text: Fast. Play when you would fail a skill test. As an additional cost to play This Time For Sure, raise Dissonance by 1. Cancel that test's results, return the revealed chaos tokens to the bag and perform the test again with the same skill and difficulty (committed cards stay committed; commit no more). You get +2 skill value for that test.

sthr-markeddeck.text:
[free] Exhaust Marked Deck: Reveal a random chaos token without resolving it, and seal it on Marked Deck. The next time you would reveal a chaos token during a skill test this round, instead release the sealed token and treat it as the revealed token. At the end of the round, release it if it is still sealed.
[free] Exhaust Marked Deck, raise Dissonance by 1 and remove 1 Memory from a card you control: Choose a non-symbol token in the chaos bag and seal it on Marked Deck. It cannot be revealed while sealed. Release it at the end of the round.

sthr-compass.text: [action] Exhaust Lucky Compass: Move to a connecting location or, if there is 1 or more Memory on Lucky Compass, to any revealed location in a district that has a Knowledge entry recorded in your Campaign Log. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

sthrcass.text:
[free] Spend 2 resources: Name a chaos token symbol other than [autofail]. The next time you reveal a token with that symbol during a skill test this round, cancel it (it has no modifier and no symbol effect) and place 1 Memory on Cass. Limit once per round.
[elder] +1. Gain 1 resource for each Memory on Cass (maximum 3).
sthrcass.elderSign: +1. Gain 1 resource for each Memory on Cass (maximum 3).

sthrayako.text:
[reaction] After you succeed at an [int] test: Place 1 Memory on Ayako. Limit once per round.
[elder] +2. Draw 1 card. If it is a Recollection, it costs 2 fewer resources to play until the end of the round.
sthrayako.elderSign: +2. Draw 1 card. If it is a Recollection, it costs 2 fewer resources to play until the end of the round.

sthr-eighthgrave.text: Revelation – If there is Memory on Elias, take 1 horror for each Memory on him (maximum 4). Otherwise, search the encounter deck and discard pile for an Echo enemy and spawn it engaged with you; it is not Sleepwalking this loop. If you cannot, take 2 horror. Shuffle the encounter deck.

sthr-longwayround.text: Move to a connecting location, then you may move to a location connecting to that one. These moves do not provoke attacks of opportunity, do not place doom on the current Hour and do not count as the first move along a district connection this round.

sthrbirdie.text:
[reaction] After you fail a skill test by 2 or more: Place 1 Memory on Birdie. Limit once per round.
[reaction] When you would fail a skill test (even because of [autofail]), remove 3 Memory from Birdie: You succeed at that test by 0 instead. Limit once per loop.
[elder] +1. If you have already failed a skill test this round, this token is +3 instead.
sthrbirdie.back_text:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards level 0–5, Neutral cards level 0–5, up to 5 other Guardian, Mystic, Rogue and/or Seeker cards level 0–1, any number of Recollection cards.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Lucky Compass, "I Get Out", Nobody Believes Her, 1 random basic weakness.

sthr-debtofhours.text: Revelation – If Dissonance is in the Noticed band, advance the Appointed's Approach by 1 stage; if the Approach is already Arrived, take 2 horror instead. Otherwise, if Dissonance is in the Glitch band, take 2 horror. Otherwise, raise Dissonance by 1.

sthr-foreknowledge.text: When you commit Foreknowledge to a skill test, you may remove 1 Memory from a card you control. If you do, Foreknowledge has [wild][wild][wild] instead of [wild] for that test.

sthr-donebefore.text: Commit only to a skill test you are performing. If you have already failed a test of the same skill type during this loop, I've Done This Before has [wild][wild][wild] instead of [wild].

sthr-musclememory.text: When you commit Muscle Memory, if you have already performed a test of this skill type during this loop, it has [wild][wild] instead of [wild] and you draw 1 card.

sthr-rememberending.text: Max once per loop. Test [wil] (X), where X is Dissonance. If you succeed, look at the next 3 Hours; the next time the Hourglass would advance before the end of the next round, cancel that advance.

sthr-seenthishand.text: Fast. Play when a chaos token is revealed during your skill test. Cancel that token (it has no modifier and no effect, even if it is [autofail]) and gain 2 resources. If it was not a number token, gain 3 resources instead.

sthrelias.text:
[reaction] When another investigator at your location would be dealt damage that is not direct damage: That damage is dealt to Elias instead; then place 1 Memory on Elias. Limit once per round.
[reaction] After an enemy attack deals damage to Elias or his assets while he is alone at his location: Place 1 Memory on Elias. Limit once per round.
[elder] +1. If there are 3 or more Memory on Elias, this token is +3 instead, and heal 1 damage from Elias.

sthr-lexicon.text:
Uses (0 secrets).
[reaction] After you succeed at an [int] test by 2 or more: Place 1 secret on The Lexicon of the Hour (maximum 5).
[free] Exhaust The Lexicon of the Hour and spend 1 secret: You get +2 [int] for this skill test.
[reaction] When a Static treachery is drawn, exhaust The Lexicon of the Hour and spend 1 secret: Cancel its revelation effect.

sthr-borrowedtime.text:
Uses (3 charges). These charges are not Memory.
[free] Exhaust Borrowed Time and spend 1 charge: Choose one – Gain 1 resource; or you get +1 skill value for this skill test.

sthr-housewins.text:
Hunter.
Spawn – The location with the most clues (the lead investigator breaks ties).
While Cass has more Memory on her cards than each other investigator, The House Always Wins cannot be evaded.
Forced – After an attack by The House Always Wins defeats an investigator: Remove 3 banked Memory.

sthr-igetout.text: Fast. Max once per loop. Play when you would be defeated by damage and/or horror. You are not defeated: heal damage and horror from you until you have 1 remaining health and 1 remaining sanity. Disengage from each enemy engaged with you and move to a connecting location. If Lucky Compass is in play, place 1 Memory on it.

sthrseraphine.text:
[free] During your turn, raise Dissonance by 1: Choose one – You get +2 skill value for this skill test; or gain 1 additional action this turn; or ready a Spell asset you control. Limit twice per round.
[reaction] After you resolve Seraphine's [free] ability for the second time this round: Place 1 Memory on Seraphine.
[elder] +X, where X is Dissonance (maximum +5). After this skill test ends, lower Dissonance by the amount this token added.
sthrseraphine.elderSign: +X, where X is Dissonance (maximum +5). After this skill test ends, lower Dissonance by the amount this token added.

sthr-cassandrasnotebook.text: [reaction] After a Knowledge entry is recorded in your Campaign Log for the first time: Draw 2 cards.

sthr-appointed.text:
Prey – Most Memory on their cards. It moves toward its prey even if other investigators are nearer.
The Appointed cannot be attacked, evaded, damaged or defeated, and leaves play only when pushed back to Unseen.
[action]: Hold Back (only while the Appointed is ready). Test [wil] (4) or [com] (4). This action does not provoke an attack of opportunity from the Appointed. If you succeed, push it back one Approach stage, disengage and exhaust it, and (except during the finale) rewind the Hourglass by 1 Hour.

sthr-minutehand.name: The Minute Hand
sthr-minutehand.flavor: It keeps perfect time. It is only ever one minute behind you.

sthr-wearssheriff.text:
Spawn – The Records Office.
While What Wears the Sheriff is in play, the Records Office gets +1 shroud.
